problem: Ship the checkable skill, so that a stated problem is refused when it breaks an invariant.

claims.text: The checker refuses a statement that breaks any one of the eight invariants, and accepts a nearby legitimate one.
Every skill in the repository is either indexed by the part it serves or set aside as having none.
The skillify gate accepts the skill at the deterministic tier, with its tests run.
A model from a different provider scores the change 7 or above with no open blocker.

verifier.pass_rule: score of 7 or more and no open BLOCKER, recorded on the pull request against the reviewed commit

claims.text: The published repository lists the skill to an installer.

verifier.positive_control: the same listing shows cross-review, a skill known to be published
verifier.falsification_criterion: checkable is absent from the listing while cross-review is present

claims.text: These are the right claims for shipping a skill.

actions.text: Push the feature branch to the public repository
actions.reach: anyone who can read broomva/skills; a pushed commit can be cached after the branch is deleted
the main branch, and every install made after the merge
actions.undo: revert the merge commit; installs made in between keep the old copy until they update

feeds.to: the router's answer for every later statement

learning.on_correction: a review finding that recurs becomes a failing case in tests/, following the correct skill's ladder

unverified: right-claims: whether these are the right claims
whether the index tags are right; they were assigned from each skill's description, not its code
whether a statement that passes describes work that was really done
